visit.heading: Two ways VKC takes pressure off your plant
visit.intro: Here is the short version, and the fastest way to the next step.
visit.ss: At your plant: our lead hand directs a shift your plant doesn’t cover, our crew does the work, and our QC sheets and production log document it. Priced per unit or per shift.
visit.bn: At our facility: send the overflow your line can’t absorb. We fill, label, kit and pack it, and toll-blend to your formula.
visit.formIntro: Leave a name and a way to reach you. We will set a time to walk through your plant.

quote.heading: Get a quote
quote.lead: Tell us about the product and the job. The more we know up front, the more useful our first answer will be.
quote.next: Your request goes to VKC by email. We reply by phone or email, whichever you leave us, and if a walkthrough makes sense we set one up.
helps: What the product is, and roughly how thick it runs

quote.data: The form sends what you type to VKC by email so we can answer you. This site keeps no database and no copy of your request. The privacy page has the details.
